name: backtest-reality-check
description: Checks whether a trading backtest survives its own statistics: deflated Sharpe, multiple-testing correction against a best-of-N-noise benchmark, minimum track record length, and fill realism. Takes no market data and no API keys, and cannot recommend a trade — it only reports that a result is weaker
